title: How to Break YouTube (Copyright Claim your own video)
summary: A guide to using YouTube's Content ID by claiming your own videos through a distributor, so the claims share revenue with the creator and monetize re-uploads. It credits another creator who pioneered the method.
why: HN cites it as an example of how easily the Content ID system can be gamed, mostly in copyright-claim discussions.

quote.text: you can copyright claim your own video and prevent others from abusing ContentID to earn money on it
